description: Docs drift: RUM site responses carry a top-level `host` (the measured hostname of gray-clouded sites) on the live wire — distilled models it — but the docs omit it, so alchemy's Site provider read undefined. Add it to create/get/update/list-item responses. Targets the docs-derived shape names; the rename patches only move op-level Request/Response shapes, and these run before manual patches so Get/Update/Create responses are addressed post-rename.
